name: Reveal to Identify
description: Choose a limited set of circular reveals through an opaque plate, gather enough visual evidence, and name the hidden procedural object.
natural_language: Spend your six reveals on useful parts of the fogged plate, then enter the hidden object's common English name.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in Peekaboom's circular reveal-and-guess role and its click-localization bonus round. The implementation uses original procedural vector objects, plate textures, interface design, generation, grading, and verification; no source image, layout, code, or game asset is copied.
metadata.notes: The initial plate contains no object pixels. A screenshot-only solution must actively choose reveal locations under a finite budget, integrate the resulting spatial evidence, and type the common object name. Full input is direct plate clicking; Simplified input exposes the same disc center through coordinate controls. The task is static between actions and has no real-time component.
